runtime.identity: local Identity Next.js app with synthetic buyer credentials

result.browserJourney: After verified account linking, Chromium saves the owned synthetic product from product detail, receives the successful buyer BFF response, opens account wishlist and observes the saved product.
result.databaseAssertion: The same product is present under the store-customer ID resolved from the verified buyer/site relationship.

limits: Synthetic credentials and test records only.
No hosted storefront, hosted database, Razorpay sandbox, real message, live transaction, migration deployment, or release was involved.
This verifies one local identity-link and wishlist journey; it does not complete Phase 2 or the eleven-phase programme.
